# @stapel/realtime 0.1.1

The client half of stapel-realtime: ONE reconnect/resume WebSocket runtime for every Stapel pair. Wire envelope v1 ({v,type,stream,payload,seq}) with the two sequences kept apart by name — `envelopeSeq` is the resume cursor, `payloadSeq` is the module's ordering key. Answers the server's heartbeat so 4408 never fires, resumes by hello{last_seq} per stream, dedups the replay/live overlap, multiplexes several streams over one socket, and reads close codes as the fleet canon does: 4403/4404/4410 are refusals (never retried), 4401 in cookie mode is a session that needs refreshing (core's SessionManager seam, then ONE reconnect, then a visible refusal), everything else is exponential backoff with full jitter and no silent give-up. Framework-free at the root; `./react` adds RealtimeProvider/useStream/useRealtimeState.

No backend Django module of its own — this is the SOCKET runtime a pair reaches for instead of writing its own: wire envelope v1, the fleet close-code table, resume by envelope seq, backoff, and the React provider/hooks. A pair that opens a socket depends on this and never re-implements it.

## Analytics events (typed; defineEvent → events.json, drift-gated)
- (no app defineEvent() in this pair — its analytic events are the
  auto-instrumented flow funnels below)

## Flow funnels (auto-instrumented: flow.<id>.<step> {phase})

```tsx
// Typed event + tracked() click (the one right way; §3.1).
const planSelected = defineEvent({
  name: "pricing.plan.selected",
  description: "User picked a plan",
  props: { plan: prop.oneOf(["free", "pro", "team"], "Plan code") },
});
const { tracked } = useTracked();
<Button onClick={tracked(planSelected, { plan }, startCheckout)} />
// A click that STEPS a flow machine is already instrumented — mark it
// data-analytics="flow" instead; tracked() on top double-counts (§3.2).
```

## Demos (defineDemo → manifest.demos; compiled, linted, rendered examples)
- realtime.connection-states → <RealtimeProvider> [connecting|live|reconnecting|unavailable|resync|refused]  demo/Realtime.demo.tsx
Each source file is the canonical usage snippet (open the default variant).

## Snippets
```tsx
// One-provider setup (StapelConfigProvider + QueryClientProvider + I18nProvider).
const client = createStapelClient({ baseUrl, getAccessToken });
<StapelProvider client={client} queryClient={queryClient} i18n={i18n}>
  <App />
</StapelProvider>
```
```tsx
// Error narrowing — never a cast (stapel/no-raw-error-shape).
if (isStapelApiError(err)) return <Alert>{t(err.code, err.params)}</Alert>;
```
